model_name: NextDue canonical rule workbook and household graph

implementation_authority.note: This file describes stable entity boundaries for research exports; executable SQL migrations remain authoritative.

principles: Household is the tenant and authorization boundary; it does not replace the person, asset, document or obligation that a record is about.
Citizenship, country context, purpose, legal route, route party and issued document are separate records.
An exact asset has repeatable country jurisdictions and repeatable dated person roles.
IssuedDocument has exactly one person or asset subject; there is no separate AssetDocument model.
RuleCandidate is separate from Obligation. Acceptance creates an obligation; dismissal is audited.
An Obligation has exactly one household, person or asset subject and a separate optional responsible person.
Unknown routes, applicability and deadlines stay unresolved; no value is inferred from a broad purpose.

rule_schema.matching_contract: Only verified/publishable exact_national_rule rows can create automatic RuleCandidates. No registry row directly creates a confirmed Obligation or invents a due date.

server_entities.name: Person
server_entities.purpose: Human subject with no embedded citizenship or residence

server_entities.name: LegalRoute
server_entities.purpose: Exact route/status for one country context

server_entities.name: RouteParty
server_entities.purpose: Employer, sponsor, institution, host or principal

server_entities.name: Asset
server_entities.purpose: Exact possession without an overloaded country or owner column

server_entities.name: AssetJurisdiction
server_entities.purpose: Repeatable location, registration, tax, use or incorporation country

server_entities.name: AssetPersonRole
server_entities.purpose: Repeatable dated owner, keeper, operator, taxpayer or responsible person

server_entities.name: RuleCandidate
server_entities.subject: exactly household, person or asset
server_entities.purpose: Human applicability decision before obligation creation

server_entities.name: ReminderDelivery
server_entities.purpose: Idempotent channel delivery for one occurrence and offset

server_entities.name: CalendarFeed
server_entities.purpose: Hashed and revocable private subscription token

server_entities.name: RuleRevision
server_entities.purpose: Immutable editorial snapshot and approval state

server_entities.name: RuleCorrection
server_entities.purpose: Correction intake linked to a resolution revision

subject_constraints.issued_document: (subject_type='person' AND person_id IS NOT NULL AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (subject_type='asset' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL AND person_id IS NULL)
subject_constraints.candidate_or_obligation: (subject_type='household' AND person_id IS NULL AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (subject_type='person' AND person_id IS NOT NULL AND asset_id IS NULL) OR (subject_type='asset' AND asset_id IS NOT NULL AND person_id IS NULL)
subject_constraints.tenant_invariant: Every private reference must resolve to the same household_id; composite foreign keys and guarded optional-reference triggers enforce this.
